items.title_en: SpaceX catches the Starship to end Flight 15
items.title_zh: SpaceX 在第 15 次飞行结束时接住星舰
items.summary_en: SpaceX's Starship Flight 15 ended with the vehicle being caught by the launch system. The available material provides no further details about the flight or the catch.
items.summary_zh: SpaceX 的星舰第 15 次飞行以发射系统接住飞行器告终。现有信息未提供这次飞行或捕获过程的更多细节。

items.title_en: Lovable apps expose passport details and more than 200K private messages
items.title_zh: Lovable 应用暴露护照信息和超过 20 万条私人消息
items.summary_en: An analysis of 159,041 Lovable projects found many cases in which personal and confidential information was accessible without logging in, including passport details and more than 200,000 private messages. Lovable is a Stockholm-based Swedish AI startup founded in 2023 by Anton Osika and Fabian Hedin, whose platform generates web applications from plain-language descriptions. The findings show that building applications with AI does not remove the need for careful handling of sensitive data.
items.summary_zh: 对 159,041 个 Lovable 项目的分析发现，许多项目无需登录即可访问个人和机密信息，其中包括护照详情以及超过 20 万条私人消息。Lovable 是一家总部位于斯德哥尔摩、由 Anton Osika 和 Fabian Hedin 于 2023 年创立的瑞典 AI 初创公司，其平台可根据自然语言描述生成 Web 应用。这些发现表明，使用 AI 构建应用并不能免除对敏感数据进行谨慎处理的要求。

items.title_en: Nvidia deliberately kept GPU prices high through circular financing deals
items.title_zh: 英伟达通过循环融资交易蓄意维持 GPU 高价
items.summary_en: The headline alleges that Nvidia deliberately kept GPU prices high through circular financing deals. No further details are available here about the transactions or the evidence behind the allegation.
items.summary_zh: 标题指称英伟达通过循环融资交易蓄意维持 GPU 高价。现有信息未提供相关交易或这一指控所依据证据的更多细节。

items.title_en: How did Woz write the Apple 1 BASIC before building the computer?
items.title_zh: Woz 在造出 Apple 1 之前是如何编写 BASIC 的？
items.summary_en: The piece asks how Steve Wozniak wrote the Apple 1 BASIC interpreter before building the Apple 1 computer. It focuses on the relationship between the software and the hardware that followed.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容提出了一个问题：Steve Wozniak 在制造 Apple 1 电脑之前，是如何编写 Apple 1 BASIC 解释器的？主题聚焦于这套软件与后来硬件之间的关系。

items.title_en: LinkedIn, Monster take down over 1000 fake job postings after CBC investigation
items.title_zh: CBC 调查后，LinkedIn 和 Monster 撤下超过 1,000 条虚假招聘信息
items.summary_en: LinkedIn and Monster removed more than 1,000 fake job postings after an investigation by CBC. The available information does not provide further details about the postings or the platforms' responses.
items.summary_zh: 在 CBC 调查之后，LinkedIn 和 Monster 撤下了超过 1,000 条虚假招聘信息。现有信息未提供这些信息或两家平台后续回应的更多细节。

items.title_en: Tech companies are trying to shift the concept of privacy again
items.title_zh: 科技公司又在试图改变隐私的定义
items.summary_en: Privacy is increasingly affecting people beyond the individual who owns or uses a device. Meta and Google’s smart glasses can record what the wearer is looking at or use AI to describe it, extending the consequences of data collection to bystanders. The shift challenges the older framing of privacy as primarily a matter of personal choice.
items.summary_zh: 隐私问题正越来越多地影响设备所有者或使用者之外的人。Meta 和 Google 的智能眼镜可以记录佩戴者所看到的内容，或使用 AI 对其进行描述，使数据收集的后果波及旁观者。这种变化挑战了过去主要将隐私视为个人选择的传统定义。

items.title_en: L3Harris statement on the Nov. 13 ground stop
items.title_zh: L3Harris 关于 11 月 13 日停飞的声明
items.summary_en: L3Harris says it has completed more than 70% of a planned conversion of National Airspace System communications from legacy copper lines to fiber optics, working with the FAA and telecommunications partners. The company is supporting the FAA's investigation into the conditions that led to the nationwide ground stop on November 13. It said safety and reliability remain its highest priorities.
items.summary_zh: L3Harris 表示，在与 FAA 和电信合作伙伴合作后，已完成国家空域系统通信从传统铜线向光纤转换计划的 70% 以上。该公司正协助 FAA 调查导致 11 月 13 日全国停飞的相关情况。公司称，安全与可靠性仍是其最高优先事项。

items.title_en: FAA issues national ground stop – lifted 4.5 hours later
items.title_zh: FAA 发布全国地面停飞令
items.summary_en: The FAA issued a national ground stop affecting departing flights. The available records identify the action but do not provide reliable details about its duration, cause, or operational impact.
items.summary_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局发布了影响出发航班的全国地面停飞令。现有记录确认了这一措施，但未提供其持续时间、原因或运行影响的可靠细节。

items.title_en: KDE: The documentary [video]
items.title_zh: KDE：纪录片 [视频]
items.summary_en: KDE: The Documentary tells the story of the open-source community that emerged in 1996 to offer computer users a free alternative to proprietary desktops such as Windows. It traces the origins and development of KDE as a pioneering desktop project.
items.summary_zh: 《KDE：纪录片》讲述了这一开源社区的故事：它于 1996 年兴起，为计算机用户提供了 Windows 等专有桌面之外的免费替代方案。影片追溯了 KDE 这一先驱桌面项目的起源与发展。

items.title_en: A family tree of software job titles
items.title_zh: 软件岗位名称家谱
items.summary_en: A software job-title family tree traces how similar work has been labeled over time, from DevOps to SRE and platform engineering. Its creator assembled the map with help from Claude, covering titles from the 1940s to the present.
items.summary_zh: 一份软件岗位名称家谱追溯了相似工作如何随着时间更名，从 DevOps 到 SRE，再到平台工程。作者在 Claude 的帮助下制作了这张图，覆盖从 1940 年代至今的岗位名称。

items.title_en: Nvidia allegedly engineered scarcity by funding AI startups to buy its GPUs
items.title_zh: 英伟达被指通过资助 AI 初创公司购买 GPU，人为制造供应紧张
items.summary_en: A new report, citing The Wall Street Journal, alleges that NVIDIA increased the GPU and memory shortage by investing in AI startups that then bought NVIDIA GPUs and built data centers. The allegation emerged after Jensen Huang’s departure as NVIDIA’s CEO, according to the supplied report. The claim concerns whether the company’s financing activity helped inflate demand for its own hardware.
items.summary_zh: 一份援引《华尔街日报》的新报告称，英伟达通过投资 AI 初创公司，促使这些公司购买英伟达 GPU 并建设数据中心，从而加剧了 GPU 和内存短缺。报告称，这一指控是在 Jensen Huang 离任英伟达 CEO 后出现的。争议焦点在于，英伟达的融资活动是否帮助推高了对其自有硬件的需求。

items.title_en: Italy fines Meta $887M over Android users' data access
items.title_zh: 意大利因 Android 用户数据访问问题对 Meta 罚款 8.87 亿美元
items.summary_en: Italy fined Meta $887 million over Android users’ data access. The case concerns Meta’s handling of data access involving users of Android devices.
items.summary_zh: 意大利因 Android 用户数据访问问题对 Meta 处以 8.87 亿美元罚款。案件涉及 Meta 如何处理 Android 设备用户的数据访问。

items.title_en: Jensen Huang resigns
items.title_zh: 黄仁勋辞职
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang has resigned. The available material does not provide reliable details about the timing, reasons, or succession. The departure marks a leadership change at Nvidia.
items.summary_zh: 黄仁勋已辞职。现有材料没有提供有关时间、原因或继任安排的可靠细节。这意味着英伟达将发生领导层变动。

items.title_en: US IRS free online tax filing open source repo (2025)
items.title_zh: 美国国税局免费在线报税开源仓库（2025）
items.summary_en: Direct File is a US government service that lets taxpayers file federal returns electronically for free and directly with the IRS. It uses interview-style questions, works across phones and computers, supports English and Spanish, and translates users' answers into tax forms submitted through the IRS Modernized e-File API. The repository contains the service's code and related tests and scenarios.
items.summary_zh: Direct File 是美国政府提供的服务，允许纳税人免费通过电子方式直接向美国国税局提交联邦税表。该服务采用问答式界面，可在手机和电脑等设备上使用，支持英语和西班牙语，并将用户答案转换为税表后通过国税局 Modernized e-File API 提交。该开源仓库包含服务代码以及相关测试和场景。

items.title_en: PyPI's redesigned project pages with clearer security signals are now live
items.title_zh: PyPI 重设计的项目页面现已上线，安全信号更加清晰
items.summary_en: PyPI has completed and launched its redesigned project pages. The new interface adds a dedicated security tab, a rebuilt release-files tab, and refreshed documentation to make package details and release-file provenance easier to inspect. The changes were shaped by user research with members of the Python community.
items.summary_zh: PyPI 已完成并上线重新设计的项目页面。新界面增加了专门的安全标签页、重做的发布文件标签页和更新后的文档，让用户更容易查看软件包详情及发布文件的来源。这些改动参考了对 Python 社区成员开展的用户研究。

items.title_en: Show HN: DeepSeek V3 in ~200 lines of pure Jax
items.title_zh: Show HN：用约 200 行纯 JAX 实现 DeepSeek V3
items.summary_en: A project implements the DeepSeek-V3 architecture in 190 lines of pure JAX, including MLA, DeepSeekMoE, auxiliary-loss-free balancing, and multi-token prediction. The model was pretrained from scratch on a MacBook Air using public-domain detective fiction, without PyTorch, Flax, or Equinox. Its parameters are plain dictionaries of arrays, and the implementation is organized as readable functions.
items.summary_zh: 一个项目用 190 行纯 JAX 实现了 DeepSeek-V3 架构，包括 MLA、DeepSeekMoE、无辅助损失均衡和多词元预测。该模型在 MacBook Air 上使用公版侦探小说从头预训练，未使用 PyTorch、Flax 或 Equinox。模型参数采用由数组组成的普通字典，代码则组织为可从头读到尾的函数。

items.title_en: Dartmouth (Guarini) will not admit math PhD cohort this year
items.title_zh: 达特茅斯大学 Guarini 学院今年不招收数学博士生
items.summary_en: Dartmouth's Guarini School of Graduate and Advanced Studies has suspended admissions to the next mathematics PhD cohort, which would have enrolled in the 2027–2028 academic year. The dean and a college spokesperson did not say when, or whether, admissions would resume. Faculty members raised concerns about the suspension at a November 9 faculty meeting.
items.summary_zh: 达特茅斯大学 Guarini 研究生与高等研究学院暂停招收下一届数学博士生，该届原计划在 2027—2028 学年入学。院长和校方发言人没有说明招生何时或是否会恢复。教职员工在 11 月 9 日的全体教师会议上对这一暂停提出了担忧。

items.title_en: Monkey Island: all 13 versions side by side
items.title_zh: 《猴岛的秘密》全部 13 个版本并排对比
items.summary_en: The project presents every version of The Secret of Monkey Island from 1990 side by side, covering eight editions and 13 display modes across systems including Hercules, CGA, EGA, VGA, Amiga, Atari ST, Macintosh, FM Towns, and Sega CD. It shows the same 12 scenes in each version, with captures scaled to 1600×1200 using nearest-neighbor scaling and corrected for a 4:3 display. The presentation keeps the framing constant so differences come from the original machines and display modes.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目并排展示了 1990 年《猴岛的秘密》的所有版本，涵盖 Hercules、CGA、EGA、VGA、Amiga、Atari ST、Macintosh、FM Towns 和 Sega CD 等平台上的 8 个版本、13 种显示模式。每个版本都展示相同的 12 个场景，截图使用最近邻算法放大到 1600×1200，并进行 4:3 显示比例校正。展示保持相同构图，因此差异主要来自原始机器和显示模式。

items.title_en: Italy fines Meta €805M over photo privacy
items.title_zh: 意大利因照片隐私问题对 Meta 处以 8.05 亿欧元罚款
items.summary_en: Italy has fined Meta €805 million over photo privacy. No further details are available about the authority's findings or the specific practices involved.
items.summary_zh: 意大利因照片隐私问题对 Meta 处以 8.05 亿欧元罚款。现有信息未提供监管机构调查结果或相关具体做法的更多细节。

items.title_en: Formalizing US Tax Code (Using Lean)
items.title_zh: 用 Lean 形式化美国税法
items.summary_en: The project aims to formalize the entire U.S. Internal Revenue Code in Lean and use formal search to find previously unknown loopholes. Lean’s type checker verifies mathematical proofs step by step from explicit definitions. Earlier experiments reportedly rediscovered known loopholes, including the backdoor Roth, by searching retirement-account rules.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目计划用 Lean 形式化整个美国《国内税收法典》，并通过形式化搜索寻找此前未知的漏洞。Lean 的类型检查器会根据明确的定义逐步验证数学证明。此前的实验据称已经通过搜索退休账户规则重新发现了包括 backdoor Roth 在内的已知漏洞。

items.title_en: Advancing science and engineering with Antigravity's /teamwork
items.title_zh: 用 Antigravity 的 /teamwork 推进科学与工程
items.summary_en: Google Research reports recent results from Antigravity’s /teamwork multi-agent systems, which are designed to support human-AI collaboration on open problems. The systems have been applied to mathematics, chemistry, systems software, and machine-learning engineering. The work was conducted with human experts, and Google says the tools are being made available externally.
items.summary_zh: Google Research 公布了 Antigravity 的 /teamwork 多代理系统的最新成果，该系统旨在支持人类与 AI 协作解决开放性问题。相关系统已应用于数学、化学、系统软件和机器学习工程领域。这些工作由人类专家参与完成，Google 表示将向外部用户提供这些工具。

items.title_en: Show HN: A terminal-native idle factory game, written in Rust with ratatui
items.title_zh: Show HN：用 Rust 和 ratatui 编写的终端原生放置工厂游戏
items.summary_en: Term inactory is a cozy factory game that runs directly in a terminal and was built for playing while waiting on long-running agent tasks. It includes basic factory mechanics such as building, deleting, selecting, measuring earnings, and researching unlocks. Additional features include a fictional browser with a wiki and forums, extensive lore, and hooks that display coding-agent responses as in-game “telegrams.”
items.summary_zh: Term inactory 是一款直接运行在终端中的休闲工厂游戏，适合在等待耗时较长的代理任务时游玩。游戏包含建造、删除、选择、收益测算和研究解锁等基本工厂机制。它还加入了带有 Wiki 和论坛的虚构浏览器、大量背景故事，以及将编码代理回复显示为游戏内“电报”的钩子功能。

items.title_en: Ggml v1.0.0
items.title_zh: ggml v1.0.0
items.summary_en: ggml 1.0.0 removes deprecated public APIs and the legacy DIAG_MASK operations, while adding configurable YaRN truncation and FP8 support. It also delivers performance work across CUDA, Metal, Vulkan, SYCL, OpenCL, WebGPU, and Hexagon backends, including quantized matrix multiplication, MoE fusion, FlashAttention paths, and scheduler improvements. The release broadens hardware and backend support while reducing unnecessary input uploads.
items.summary_zh: ggml 1.0.0 移除了已弃用的公共 API 和旧版 DIAG_MASK 操作，并加入可配置的 YaRN 截断和 FP8 支持。该版本还改进了 CUDA、Metal、Vulkan、SYCL、OpenCL、WebGPU 和 Hexagon 后端的性能，包括量化矩阵乘法、MoE 融合、FlashAttention 路径和调度器优化。此次发布扩大了硬件与后端支持，并减少了不必要的输入上传。

items.title_en: Serving GLM-5.3 at 607.8 tok/s across two Nvidia DGX stations with vLLM
items.title_zh: 使用 vLLM 在两台英伟达 DGX 工作站上以 607.8 token/s 部署 GLM-5.3
items.summary_en: The deployment uses two NVIDIA DGX Stations connected by ConnectX-8 RDMA to serve GLM-5.3 through one endpoint. Tensor parallelism splits the model’s weights and computation across the systems. The NVFP4 model has 753 billion parameters, activates 40 billion per token, and occupies about 464 GB, exceeding the 252 GB of HBM3e on a single GB300 GPU, so the setup keeps all weights in GPU memory without CPU offload.
items.summary_zh: 该部署使用两台通过 ConnectX-8 RDMA 连接的 NVIDIA DGX 工作站，通过单一端点提供 GLM-5.3 服务。张量并行将模型权重和计算任务拆分到两台机器上。这个 NVFP4 模型拥有 7530 亿个参数，每个 token 激活 400 亿个参数，占用约 464 GB，超过单块 GB300 GPU 的 252 GB HBM3e，因此该方案不启用 CPU 权重卸载，而是将全部权重保存在 GPU 内存中。

items.title_en: Project Zero will disclose vulnerabilities 90 days after reporting
items.title_zh: Project Zero 将在报告漏洞 90 天后公开信息
items.summary_en: Since 2021, Project Zero has followed a 90-plus-30-day disclosure policy, giving vendors 90 days to remediate a vulnerability and an additional 30 days for patch rollout. It says AI-assisted vulnerability discovery and exploitation have increased the immediate risk posed by newly reported bugs. Project Zero is therefore changing its policy to encourage faster remediation and disclosure after 90 days.
items.summary_zh: 自 2021 年起，Project Zero 采用“90+30 天”披露政策，给予厂商 90 天修复漏洞，另加 30 天用于推广补丁。该团队表示，AI 辅助的漏洞发现与利用提高了新报告漏洞的即时风险。因此，Project Zero 将调整政策，以推动更快修复，并在报告 90 天后披露漏洞信息。

items.title_en: A visual explanation of reinforcement learning
items.title_zh: 强化学习的可视化解释
items.summary_en: The interactive explanation builds a digital being with a simple brain and observes it learning a new behavior. It follows an earlier creature called a spark, which could steer toward light, and shows how small changes to its neural circuitry produced very different behaviors. The presentation uses the creature’s learning process to illustrate reinforcement learning.
items.summary_zh: 这个交互式教程构建了一个拥有简单大脑的数字生物，并观察它学习新行为的过程。它延续了此前名为 spark 的生物：该生物能够朝光源转向，而神经回路的微小变化会产生截然不同的行为。教程通过这种学习过程解释强化学习。

items.title_en: Terminal borders that don't cost a cell
items.title_zh: 不占用终端单元格的边框
items.summary_en: A proposed terminal protocol draws thin borders, rounded corners, and gridlines along cell edges without consuming rows or columns. The implementation works in Ghostty, with demos built using Ratatui. It aims to give terminal user interfaces more visual design options than conventional box-based layouts.
items.summary_zh: 一种新的终端协议可以沿单元格边缘绘制细线、圆角和网格线，而不占用额外的行或列。该实现可在 Ghostty 中运行，并提供了使用 Ratatui 构建的演示。它旨在为终端用户界面提供比传统方框布局更多的视觉设计选择。

items.title_en: Silicon Valley claims to know the future. So why'd it get the midterms so wrong?
items.title_zh: 硅谷自称看得见未来，为何却错判了中期选举？
items.summary_en: The piece criticizes Silicon Valley executives who portray themselves as long-term visionaries but pursued short-term political gains. It cites leaders including Sam Altman, Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg, and Google, and notes that several executives appeared at the White House shortly before the midterm elections to support President Trump's “Super Intelligence” agenda. The argument is that this political alignment damaged their claims to foresight and judgment.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容批评那些自称具有长期远见、却追逐短期政治利益的硅谷高管。文章提到 Sam Altman、Elon Musk、Mark Zuckerberg 和 Google 等领导者，并指出一些高管在中期选举前不久现身白宫，支持特朗普总统的“超级智能”议程。文章认为，这种政治站队损害了他们关于远见和判断力的自我定位。

items.title_en: Will we put data centers in space?
items.title_zh: 我们会把数据中心建在太空吗？
items.summary_en: The research examines whether AI data centers could move into orbit, considering launch costs, cooling physics, engineering constraints, and governance factors. It focuses on what would be required to make space-based computing viable.
items.summary_zh: 这项研究考察 AI 数据中心是否可能迁入轨道，并分析发射成本、冷却物理、工程限制和治理因素。研究重点是让太空计算具备可行性所需的条件。

items.title_en: Show HN: Agweb – a browser for agents that stays out of your way
items.title_zh: Show HN：Agweb——不妨碍用户操作的代理浏览器
items.summary_en: Agweb is a macOS browser for coding agents, built on WebKit and designed not to steal keyboard focus. Agents control the single window from the shell through an agweb command modeled on Playwright CLI, while users can watch all tabs live in one view. Idle tabs are suspended; the author reports that five open pages used 0% CPU on a Mac, compared with five to seven busy cores from Chrome’s GPU process.
items.summary_zh: Agweb 是一款面向编码代理的 macOS 浏览器，基于 WebKit 构建，设计目标是不抢占键盘焦点。代理通过类似 Playwright CLI 的 agweb 命令从 shell 控制这个窗口，用户则可以在一个视图中实时查看所有标签页。闲置标签页会被挂起；作者称，在 Mac 上打开五个页面时其 CPU 占用为 0%，而 Chrome 的 GPU 进程会占用五到七个繁忙核心。

items.title_en: Demystifying phone unlocking tools: A technical overview
items.title_zh: 手机解锁工具揭秘：技术概览
items.summary_en: This is a technical overview of tools used to unlock mobile phones. The available material provides no further details about the tools or techniques covered.
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇关于手机解锁工具的技术概览。现有信息未提供所涉及工具或技术的更多细节。

items.title_en: AI unlocks Gödel's notebooks, said to contain hundreds of proved theorems
items.title_zh: AI 解读哥德尔笔记本，据称其中包含数百个已证明定理
items.summary_en: Kurt Gödel left 1,009 pages of densely written material, much of it in an obsolete shorthand, and the notebooks are said to contain hundreds of proved theorems. Gödel’s published incompleteness theorems transformed mathematics and helped pave the way for the digital age. His unpublished work spans tens of thousands of pages and remains of interest to historians of science.
items.summary_zh: 库尔特·哥德尔留下了 1,009 页密集书写的材料，其中许多使用已过时的速记，据称笔记本里包含数百个已证明定理。哥德尔发表的不完备性定理改变了数学，并为数字时代铺平了道路。他未发表的作品多达数万页，至今仍受到科学史学者关注。

items.title_en: $11.4M in Nvidia hardware vanishes during shipment from CA to TX
items.title_zh: 价值 1,140 万美元的英伟达硬件在从加州运往德州途中失踪
items.summary_en: Six pallets of NVIDIA computer hardware, reportedly worth $11.4 million, disappeared during shipment from Oakland, California, to Fort Worth, Texas. The truck was collected on August 29, made several extended stops, and was last tracked in San Bernardino County. Oakland police confirmed an ongoing grand-theft investigation, while the carrier’s identity and the circumstances remain unclear.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，六托盘英伟达计算机硬件在从加州奥克兰运往德州沃思堡途中失踪，价值 1,140 万美元。卡车于 8 月 29 日提货，途中多次长时间停留，最后在圣贝纳迪诺县失去踪迹。奥克兰警方已确认正在调查这起重大盗窃案，但承运方身份和货物失踪经过仍不清楚。

items.title_zh: KORS 全频段直播航空无线电；加拿大维多利亚也实施地面停飞

It lets listeners monitor all channels at once, choose individual channels, or rewind to earlier transmissions. The title also reports that Victoria, Canada, was placed under a ground stop.

items.title_en: Creating a self booting ZIP archive
items.title_zh: 创建自启动 ZIP 归档
items.summary_en: The project considers how early userspace and initramfs could work with archive formats. It notes that Linux initramfs supports the simple, standardized CPIO format, while proposals to use TAR face questions related to standardization and fragmentation.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目探讨了早期用户空间和 initramfs 如何使用归档格式。文中指出，Linux initramfs 支持简单且标准化的 CPIO 格式，而改用 TAR 的提议面临标准化和格式碎片化方面的问题。

items.title_zh: Rust 1.100

items.title_en: Reverse engineering my Coway air purifier to ditch the cloud
items.title_zh: 逆向工程我的 Coway 空气净化器，摆脱云端控制
items.summary_en: During the 2017 wave of annual wildfires on the West Coast, many Bay Area residents bought air purifiers because their homes were poorly insulated and sealed. The author describes buying a Coway Airmega to avoid breathing wildfire soot and reverse-engineering it to remove its dependence on cloud services. The project reflects a broader effort to keep household devices locally controlled.
items.summary_zh: 2017 年西海岸接连发生野火时，许多湾区居民因为房屋隔热和密封性能较差而购买空气净化器，以避免吸入野火烟尘。作者介绍了自己购买 Coway Airmega，并对其进行逆向工程，以摆脱对云端服务的依赖。这一项目体现了将家用设备控制权保留在本地的尝试。

items.title_en: Unsloth Qwen3.8-27B Quantizations – Dynamic v3.1 Update
items.title_zh: Unsloth Qwen3.8-27B 量化模型——Dynamic v3.1 更新
items.summary_en: Unsloth’s Qwen3.8-27B is a 27-billion-parameter dense model with vision and reasoning capabilities, a 256K context window, and local operation on systems with 17 GB of RAM or VRAM. It is available through Unsloth GGUFs, NVFP4, and Unsloth Desktop. The Dynamic V3.1 quantizations reportedly improve average accuracy by 5–10% at comparable sizes on benchmarks including Terminal Bench and DeepSWE.
items.summary_zh: Unsloth 的 Qwen3.8-27B 是一款拥有 270 亿参数的稠密模型，支持视觉和推理能力，具备 256K 上下文窗口，可在 17 GB 内存或显存的设备上本地运行。它可通过 Unsloth GGUF、NVFP4 和 Unsloth Desktop 使用。Dynamic V3.1 量化版本据称在相近模型大小下，将 Terminal Bench、DeepSWE 等基准的平均准确率提高了 5% 至 10%。

items.title_en: Show HN: Fursoy – Out-of-order RV64IMAFDV core in SystemVerilog (Linux 6.6)
items.title_zh: Show HN：用 SystemVerilog 编写、支持乱序执行的 RV64IMAFDV 核心（Linux 6.6）
items.summary_en: Fursoy is a 64-bit out-of-order superscalar RISC-V processor implemented in SystemVerilog. It supports RV64IMAFDV with Zba and Zbb extensions, boots mainline Linux 6.6.50 and BusyBox under Sv39 virtual memory, and includes separate machine, supervisor, and user privilege levels. Synthesis in Nangate 45nm reached 500 MHz timing closure across eight core functional blocks.
items.summary_zh: Fursoy 是一款用 SystemVerilog 实现的 64 位乱序超标量 RISC-V 处理器。它支持带 Zba 和 Zbb 扩展的 RV64IMAFDV，可在 Sv39 虚拟内存下启动主线 Linux 6.6.50 和 BusyBox，并具备机器、监管者和用户三级权限。该设计在 Nangate 45nm 工艺中完成了八个核心功能模块的 500 MHz 时序收敛。

items.title_zh: 走私 150 万块 AI GPU 可能导致黄仁勋离职
items.summary_en: Analyst firm SemiAnalysis says it has tracked 1.5 gigawatts of banned AI accelerators flowing into China. The material presents hardware smuggling as a possible reason Jensen Huang may have had to leave the company he co-founded, but provides no confirmation of that claim.

items.title_en: Elephants found to be increasingly isolated leading to fractured social networks
items.title_zh: 大象日益孤立，社会网络逐渐碎片化
items.summary_en: Researchers studying Asian elephants found that declining populations are producing more isolated and fractured communities. They warn that the animals may be approaching a social tipping point that could harm their future. Asian elephants rely on group networks to cooperate in obtaining food and caring for young.
items.summary_zh: 研究亚洲象社会动态的学者发现，数量下降正在造成更加孤立、更加碎片化的群体。研究人员警告，大象可能正在接近一个会危及其未来的社会性临界点。亚洲象依靠群体网络合作获取食物并照料幼崽。

items.title_en: Copper wire upgrade caused nationwide flight suspension
items.title_zh: 铜线升级导致全国航班暂停
items.summary_en: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said a nationwide ground stop that caused thousands of flight cancellations followed an issue during a copper-wire upgrade. The US government is investigating whether the disruption resulted from incompetence or faulty equipment.
items.summary_zh: 美国交通部长 Sean Duffy 表示，一次铜线升级过程中出现问题，导致全国停飞并造成数千个航班取消。美国政府正在调查这次中断究竟源于无能失误还是设备故障。

items.title_en: After 600 experiments, here's what I discovered about JEPA world models
items.title_zh: 经过 600 次实验，我对 JEPA 世界模型有了这些发现
items.summary_en: The author reports conducting 600 experiments on JEPA world models. The work is framed against a debate over whether world models should generate future pixels or instead learn representations focused on information useful for decision-making. Supporters of the latter view, including Yann LeCun, argue that many pixels are irrelevant or inherently unpredictable for planning long-horizon tasks.
items.summary_zh: 作者报告称围绕 JEPA 世界模型进行了 600 次实验。相关工作置于一场争论之中：世界模型究竟应生成未来像素，还是应学习聚焦于决策有用信息的表示。包括 Yann LeCun 在内的支持者认为，许多像素与规划无关，或本身就无法被准确预测。

items.title_en: FM-1 Workbench
items.title_zh: FM-1 工作台
items.summary_en: FM1 Workbench has eight tracks, six sound sources, and 16 built-in projects. Each track supports 16, 32, 48, or 64 steps. Common operations use single-button controls, while detailed adjustments are available through long-press menus and the web interface.
items.summary_zh: FM1 Workbench 拥有 8 条音轨、6 种音源和 16 个内置工程。每条音轨支持 16、32、48 或 64 步。常用操作通过单键完成，详细调整则可在长按菜单和网页界面中进行。

items.title_en: Show HN: Live map of U.S. flights during tonight's FAA nationwide ground stop
items.title_zh: Show HN：全国 FAA 地面停飞期间的美国航班实时地图
items.summary_en: The project provides a live and replayable map of U.S. air traffic during the November 13, 2026 FAA nationwide ground stop. It compares airborne flights with a normal Friday, and displays departures and backlogs at major airports. Aircraft positions come from the community ADS-B network, while airport delay data comes from FAA NAS Status; the map is unofficial and independent of the FAA.
items.summary_zh: 该项目提供 2026 年 11 月 13 日 FAA 全国地面停飞期间美国空中交通的实时及回放地图。地图将当时的空中航班与普通周五进行对比，并显示航班起飞情况及主要机场的积压。飞机位置来自社区 ADS-B 网络，机场延误数据来自 FAA NAS Status；该地图为独立的非官方项目。

items.title_en: Amtrak booking system experiencing major issues amid nationwide FAA ground stop
items.title_zh: 全国 FAA 地面停飞期间，Amtrak 订票系统出现严重故障
items.summary_en: Amtrak’s ticket-booking system was reportedly down on Friday evening. The disruption occurred as thousands of travelers across the United States dealt with a nationwide FAA ground stop. An error message appeared on Amtrak’s website when users tried to book tickets.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，Amtrak 的订票系统于周五晚间宕机。与此同时，美国各地数千名旅客正应对 FAA 实施的全国地面停飞。用户尝试购票时，Amtrak 网站显示错误消息。

items.title_en: Show HN: My $300 embroidery machine needed a subscription, so I built my own app
items.title_zh: Show HN：我的 300 美元刺绣机需要订阅，于是我自己写了应用
items.summary_en: A developer built a replacement app for a $300 embroidery machine that required a subscription. The project is published as Zigzag. The available description does not provide further technical details about the machine or the application.
items.summary_zh: 一名开发者为一台需要订阅的 300 美元刺绣机编写了替代应用。该项目以 Zigzag 的形式发布。现有描述没有提供有关机器或应用的更多技术细节。

items.title_en: What happened to 3Com?
items.title_zh: 3Com 后来怎么样了？
items.summary_en: 3Com was a major maker of network cards and other networking equipment, founded in 1979 by Ethernet co-inventor Bob Metcalfe. During the dot-com boom, it was valued at about $5.8 billion and its cards were widely used, despite problems with the 3C501. The company later disappeared in 2009 after a series of missteps left it vulnerable to Cisco and Intel.
items.summary_zh: 3Com 曾是网络卡和其他网络设备的重要制造商，由以太网共同发明者鲍勃·梅特卡夫于 1979 年创立。互联网泡沫时期，公司市值约 58 亿美元，其网卡广泛使用，尽管 3C501 型号问题重重。此后，一系列失误使 3Com 易受思科和英特尔竞争影响，并于 2009 年逐渐退出市场。

items.title_en: Found: A protein that drives ageing without unleashing inflammation
items.title_zh: 发现：一种推动衰老却不会引发炎症的蛋白质
items.summary_en: Researchers identified granzyme K as an enzyme that drives ageing-related changes in body tissues. Mice engineered to lack the enzyme showed improved heart and liver function and less kidney damage, while liver stiffening and scarring declined. Drugs that reduce the protein could potentially target ageing effects without impairing immune defenses, although that application remains prospective.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员发现，颗粒酶 K 是一种会推动身体组织衰老变化的酶。经过基因改造、缺乏该酶的小鼠心脏和肝脏功能有所改善，肾脏损伤也更少，肝脏硬化和瘢痕减少。降低这种蛋白质水平的药物未来或许能针对衰老影响，同时不损害免疫防御，但这一应用仍属于前景设想。

items.title_en: Show HN: Isometric SF – A pixel-art map of the SF Bay Area
items.title_zh: Show HN：等距旧金山——旧金山湾区像素艺术地图
items.summary_en: The project transforms 1,300 square miles of Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles covering the San Francisco Bay Area into a cohesive pixel-art map. It includes landmarks such as Apple Park, the Palace of Fine Arts, and UC Berkeley. The creator used LoRA fine-tuning with Qwen and Klein models, estimating that using the larger Nano Banana 2 model for the final map would have cost about $7,000.
items.summary_zh: 该项目将覆盖旧金山湾区、面积达 1,300 平方英里的 Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles 转换为统一的像素艺术地图。地图包含 Apple Park、艺术宫和加州大学伯克利分校等地标。作者使用 Qwen 和 Klein 模型进行 LoRA 微调，并估计若用更大的 Nano Banana 2 制作最终地图，成本约为 7,000 美元。

items.title_en: How Not to Build a Music Player
items.title_zh: 如何不要制作音乐播放器
items.summary_en: The author began archiving music and seeking offline alternatives after an internet shutdown made online music players impractical under an oppressive regime. Strawberry provided a feature-rich offline option, but its internet-fetched lyrics were sometimes not synchronized and displayed distracting timestamps. The experience led the author to consider alternatives such as foobar2000.
items.summary_zh: 互联网关闭后，在线音乐播放器在压制性政权环境下变得不切实际，作者因此开始归档音乐并寻找离线替代方案。功能丰富的 Strawberry 一度满足需求，但其联网获取的歌词有时不同步，还会显示令人分心的时间戳。这段经历让作者开始考虑 foobar2000 等其他播放器。

items.title_en: A technical vision for the Haskell ecosystem
items.title_zh: Haskell 生态系统的技术愿景
items.summary_en: The Haskell Foundation’s technical leadership committee has been successfully established and is now fully operational. It has spent the past few weeks discussing its vision and strategy. The committee plans to develop initiatives and proposals requiring funding and execution, with participation from companies, contractors, volunteers, and the wider community.
items.summary_zh: Haskell Foundation 的技术领导委员会已经完成组建，目前正式运作。委员会过去几周一直在讨论愿景和战略。接下来，它计划推动需要资金和执行的项目与提案，并邀请企业、承包商、志愿者及更广泛的社区参与。

items.title_en: Why is there anything at all?
items.title_zh: 为什么会有任何东西存在？
items.summary_en: “Why is there anything at all?” is a question about the reason for basic existence, discussed by philosophers and physicists including Leibniz, Wittgenstein, and Heidegger. It is often called a fundamental question of metaphysics. The excerpt notes that no experiment could support the hypothesis of absolute nothingness, because any observation implies an observer exists.
items.summary_zh: “为什么会有任何东西存在？”这一问题探讨基本存在的原因，莱布尼茨、维特根斯坦和海德格尔等哲学家与物理学家都曾讨论过它。它通常被称为形而上学的根本问题。摘录指出，任何实验都无法支持“绝对虚无”这一假说，因为任何观察都意味着存在观察者。

items.title_en: US aviation shutdown blamed on L3 Harris installed router

items.title_en: With Little Ado, Congress Put God in Pledge in 1954
items.title_zh: 少有波澜：国会于 1954 年将“上帝”写入效忠誓词
items.summary_en: In 1954, Congress added the words “under God” to the Pledge of Allegiance to emphasize the contrast between the US system of government and “godless Communism.” The change occurred amid political upheaval that included McCarthy's anti-Communist campaign, Cold War tensions, and a Supreme Court ruling against school segregation.
items.summary_zh: 1954 年，国会将“under God”（信仰上帝）加入《效忠誓词》，以强调美国政府制度与“无神的共产主义”之间的差异。这一变化发生在政治动荡时期，当时美国正经历麦卡锡的反共运动、冷战紧张局势，以及最高法院裁定学校种族隔离违宪等事件。

items.title_en: Minnesota guitarist's "palmfrets" invention strikes a new chord
items.title_zh: 明尼苏达吉他手发明“掌上品格”，奏响新乐章

items.summary_en: The material points to an analysis claiming that Chinese frontier AI models carry identifiable characteristics of export-controlled GPUs. No further methodological details or conclusions are available here.

items.title_en: Perplexity Decider v1.3: Training, eval, and use cases
items.title_zh: Perplexity Decider v1.3：训练、评测与使用场景

items.summary_en: It also introduces unsure, a dependency-free Go package implementing these structures, with core logic typically ranging from 100 to 300 lines and performance usually several times faster than other implementations.

items.title_en: Live-migration support in FreeBSD and bhyve coming
items.title_zh: FreeBSD 和 bhyve 即将支持实时迁移
items.summary_en: A first working implementation can live-migrate a running amd64 bhyve guest between two FreeBSD 15.1 hosts over TCP. The guest continues running during pre-copy memory transfer and dirty-page tracking, pausing only for the final stop-and-copy phase. The work adds migration support to the vmm kernel module, bhyve, and bhyvectl, while building on experimental snapshot support.
items.summary_zh: 一项初步可用的实现可以通过 TCP，在两台 FreeBSD 15.1 主机之间实时迁移运行中的 amd64 bhyve 虚拟机。虚拟机在预复制内存传输和脏页跟踪期间继续运行，仅在最后的停止并复制阶段暂停。该工作为 vmm 内核模块、bhyve 和 bhyvectl 增加了迁移支持，并建立在实验性快照功能之上。

items.title_en: Weight Space Misfolding
items.title_zh: 权重空间错折
items.summary_en: Weight-space editing directly changes a neural network’s knowledge, behavior, or alignment. The work calls the possibility that one model induces unauthorized behavior in another “weight space misfolding,” including direct interference and possible onward propagation. It presents a threat model centered on the asymmetry between generating one harmful payload and detecting it among a model’s weights.
items.summary_zh: 权重空间编辑会直接改变神经网络的知识、行为或对齐状态。该研究将一个模型诱导另一个模型产生未授权行为的可能性称为“权重空间错折”，并讨论直接干预及潜在的继续传播。研究提出了一个威胁模型，重点关注攻击者只需生成一次恶意载荷，而防御者却必须在模型权重中搜寻它这一不对称性。

items.title_en: Lonewolf 0.3 – A standalone XMPP server written in Rust
items.title_zh: Lonewolf 0.3：用 Rust 编写的独立 XMPP 服务器
items.summary_en: Lonewolf 0.3.0 adds certificate-authenticated federation, direct TLS, and additional desktop-client features. It remains a pre-1.0, single-node server, while full XMPP compliance and clustering are still on the roadmap. The release expands secure federation without yet providing those larger deployment features.
items.summary_zh: Lonewolf 0.3.0 新增基于证书认证的联邦通信、直接 TLS，以及更多桌面客户端功能。它仍是一个处于 1.0 之前阶段的单节点服务器，完整 XMPP 兼容性和集群支持仍在路线图中。此次更新增强了安全联邦能力，但尚未提供这些更大规模部署功能。

items.title_en: The Myth of Neutral Code
items.title_zh: 中立代码的神话
items.summary_en: The essay challenges the corporate idea that open-source software is apolitical, neutral, and governed purely by technical merit. It describes a recurring argument that codes of conduct and attention to problematic individuals have made software political and damaged an earlier meritocracy. The discussion frames open-source tools as products of social and institutional choices rather than neutral utilities.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章质疑一种企业化观念：开源软件是非政治的、中立的，并且完全由技术 merit 统治。文章描述了一种反复出现的说法，即行为准则以及对项目中有争议人物的关注让软件变得政治化，并破坏了过去的技术 meritocracy。文章将开源工具视为社会和制度选择的产物，而非中立的工具。

items.title_en: The Dawn of the Data Intelligence Engineer
items.title_zh: 数据智能工程师的黎明
items.summary_en: AI has changed data-team work by allowing agents to handle much of the traditional workload. MotherDuck co-founder and data engineer Nick Ursa says he has no backlog for the first time in his career, yet remains busier because people must verify answers produced by LLMs and agents. The role is shifting from calculating correct numbers to ensuring that machine-generated numbers are correct.
items.summary_zh: AI 让代理能够承担许多传统数据团队工作，正在改变数据团队的工作方式。MotherDuck 联合创始人兼数据工程师 Nick Ursa 表示，这是他职业生涯中第一次没有待办积压，但他仍比过去更忙，因为人工仍需核验大语言模型和代理生成的答案。这个岗位正从计算正确数字，转向确保机器生成的数字正确。

items.title_en: Light Pollution Map
items.title_zh: 光污染地图
items.summary_en: The map lets users explore 2026 light-pollution estimates alongside the latest 2025 annual satellite layer. It provides Bortle class, sky-quality meter readings, and dark-sky conditions for any location.
items.summary_zh: 这张地图允许用户查看 2026 年光污染估算数据，以及最新的 2025 年年度卫星图层。它还能显示任意地点的 Bortle 等级、天空质量计数值和暗空状况。

items.title_en: Agile Manifesto for Agents
items.title_zh: 面向智能体的敏捷宣言
items.summary_en: The proposed manifesto gives teams using coding agents twelve rules, including understanding scope before implementation, coordinating bounded work, and delivering software an enterprise can operate. It warns that multiple agents can produce conflicting interpretations, incompatible interfaces, and more changes than teams can review. A successful agent run alone does not show that a useful system has been delivered.
items.summary_zh: 这份宣言为使用编码智能体的团队提出了十二条原则，包括在实现前理解范围、协调边界明确的工作，以及交付企业能够运维的软件。它警告说，多个智能体可能产生相互冲突的需求理解、不兼容的接口，以及团队无法充分审查的大量改动。一次成功的智能体运行本身，并不能证明团队交付了有用的系统。

items.title_en: Ctrl+C, Ctrl+v, Ctrl+cve: Bypassing Android's Clipboard Read Security Measures
items.title_zh: Ctrl+C、Ctrl+V、Ctrl+CVE：绕过 Android 剪贴板读取安全措施
items.summary_en: The post concerns bypassing Android’s security measures that restrict clipboard reads. It focuses on techniques represented by the “Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, Ctrl+CVE” framing.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章关注绕过 Android 限制剪贴板读取的安全措施。内容聚焦于标题所概括的“Ctrl+C、Ctrl+V、Ctrl+CVE”相关技术。

items.title_en: Too Many Stadiums with Roofs
items.title_zh: 屋顶体育场太多了
items.summary_en: The piece argues that modern cities are building too many football stadiums with roofs. It uses the planned Washington Commanders stadium as an example; the venue is expected to open in 2030 and has an announced cost of $2.7 billion.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容认为，现代城市正在建造过多带屋顶的橄榄球场。文章以规划中的华盛顿指挥官队体育场为例：该场馆预计于 2030 年开放，公布造价为 27 亿美元。

items.title_en: CERN Built the Large Hadron Collider's Next-Gen Magnets
items.title_zh: CERN 制造大型强子对撞机的下一代磁体
items.summary_en: CERN researchers are developing and testing new niobium-tin (Nb₃Sn) superconducting magnet coils for upgrades to the Large Hadron Collider. The magnets reach 11.3 tesla and use new materials and manufacturing processes. The stronger magnets are intended to let the collider bring more particles into collision.
items.summary_zh: CERN 研究人员正在为大型强子对撞机升级开发并测试新的铌锡（Nb₃Sn）超导磁体线圈。这些磁体达到 11.3 特斯拉，并采用了新材料和制造工艺。更强的磁体旨在让对撞机实现更多粒子的碰撞。

items.title_en: DeepSeek Ultrafast
items.title_zh: DeepSeek Ultrafast
items.summary_en: DeepSeek Ultrafast is an inference engine for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash targeting NVIDIA sm_100a and sm_103a hardware. It supports a 1-million-token context length and multi-server KV-cache sharing. The project measures decode speed, step time, and acceptance length using a Tetris-generation prompt.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek Ultrafast 是面向 NVIDIA sm_100a 和 sm_103a 硬件的 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 推理引擎。它支持 100 万 token 的上下文长度和多服务器 KV 缓存共享。项目使用生成俄罗斯方块的提示词测量解码速度、步骤耗时和接受长度。

items.title_en: Open-source AI without Jensen
items.title_zh: 没有黄仁勋的开源 AI
items.summary_en: It also questions who benefits from the sequence of events, while offering no further factual details in the available excerpt.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容将一位重要开源 AI 倡导者和竞争者的离去描述为一次重大打击。文章还质疑这一连串事件的受益者，但现有摘录未提供更多事实细节。

items.title_en: Why get an expensive Pi when I have an old phone?
items.title_zh: 既然有旧手机，为什么还要买昂贵的树莓派？
items.summary_en: The project uses a rooted second-hand Redmi smartphone as a camera and light controller instead of building the system around a Raspberry Pi. The phone already provides a high-resolution camera, GPS, storage, battery, and mobile data, while the original Raspberry Pi design required adding an Arducam 64MP camera and a GPS module. The approach could reduce the number of components and the project’s growing bill.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目改用一部已取得 root 权限的二手 Redmi 手机来充当摄像头和灯光控制器，而不是围绕树莓派搭建系统。手机已经具备高分辨率摄像头、GPS、存储、电池和移动数据功能；原先的树莓派方案则需要额外加入 Arducam 6400 万像素摄像头和 GPS 模块。这种做法有望减少组件数量，并控制不断上涨的项目成本。

items.title_en: Let's Write a PostScript Interpreter
items.title_zh: 编写一个 PostScript 解释器
items.summary_en: The tutorial builds an interpreter for an interesting subset of the PostScript programming language. It deliberately ignores or simplifies many features and most error handling, while ensuring that the examples behave the same in the toy implementation and in a standard interpreter such as Ghostscript. The project presents implementing a language as a practical, human-scale programming exercise.
items.summary_zh: 这篇教程将实现 PostScript 编程语言的一个有代表性的子集。教程会忽略或简化许多功能以及大部分错误处理，但确保示例在这个简化实现和 Ghostscript 等标准解释器中的行为一致。项目将编写语言呈现为一项切实可行、适合个人完成的编程练习。

items.title_en: Why platform teams fail (and AI makes it worse)
items.title_zh: 平台团队为何失败（以及 AI 如何让情况更糟）
items.summary_en: It draws on observations from nearly a decade of work with platform teams across companies of different sizes and maturity levels. The proposed lessons concern golden paths, guardrails, and organizational buy-in.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容探讨了平台团队为何经常变成换了名称的运维团队，并认为生成式 AI 正在加速这一失调循环。作者基于近十年来与不同规模、不同成熟度公司的平台团队合作和观察，总结了相关经验。讨论的重点包括黄金路径、防护栏和组织支持。

items.title_en: Vercel should fork and maintain Deno
items.title_zh: Vercel 应该 fork 并维护 Deno
items.summary_en: The proposal argues that Vercel should take over Deno after its acquisition by Cloudflare and the stated plan to eventually sunset it. The author says Vercel has the resources to maintain the project and expresses interest in working on that effort. The post asks how Deno should continue after the Cloudflare acquisition.
items.summary_zh: 这项提议认为，在 Deno 被 Cloudflare 收购且后者已表示最终会停止其项目之后，Vercel 应该接手并维护 Deno。作者认为 Vercel 具备维护该项目所需的资源，并表示有兴趣参与这项工作。帖子还征询 Deno 在 Cloudflare 收购后的发展方向。

items.title_en: A few drawings about Linux (2016)
items.title_zh: 几幅关于 Linux 的图画（2016）
items.summary_en: The author spent several days drawing one picture about Linux each day and collected the results in this series. The drawings cover topics such as /proc and were intended to make unfamiliar Linux concepts easier to discover.
items.summary_zh: 作者连续数日每天绘制一幅关于 Linux 的图画，并将成果整理成这一系列。图画涉及 /proc 等主题，旨在帮助读者发现并理解不熟悉的 Linux 概念。

items.title_en: Show HN: Infinite Shaders
items.title_zh: Show HN：无限着色器
items.summary_en: Infinite Shaders generates randomized Three.js shaders through the Shaderfrog hybrid graph editor. It presents an interactive way to create varied shader results.
items.summary_zh: Infinite Shaders 通过 Shaderfrog 混合图编辑器生成随机化的 Three.js 着色器。它提供了一种交互式方式来创建多样化的着色效果。

items.title_en: 'Grey Rocking': The Life-Improving Power of Being Really, Really Boring (2021)
items.title_zh: “灰色岩石法”：极度无聊也能改善生活的力量（2021）
items.summary_en: The grey rock technique recommends responding to difficult people with deliberately uninteresting, emotionally neutral behavior. The term was coined in 2012 by an American mental-health blogger using the pseudonym Skylar, after she left a 25-year relationship she considered abusive and dangerous. The technique has since been described as useful in both serious and everyday situations.
items.summary_zh: “灰色岩石法”建议人们以刻意无趣且情绪中立的方式回应难以相处的人。这个术语由一名使用 Skylar 笔名的美国心理健康博主于 2012 年提出，当时她刚结束一段持续 25 年、被自己认为具有虐待性和危险性的关系。此后，这一技巧被描述为既适用于严肃情境，也适用于日常场景。

items.title_en: Show HN: Shotoku – Local-first action governance and budget caps for AI agents
items.title_zh: Show HN：Shotoku——面向 AI 智能体的本地优先行动治理与预算上限
items.summary_en: Shotoku gives AI agents spending limits, human approvals, and a tamper-evident audit trail enforced locally before a payment occurs. It requires no cloud service or custody of funds, and is designed to make every autonomous action pass through a decision process.
items.summary_zh: Shotoku 为 AI 智能体提供支出上限、人工审批和防篡改审计记录，并在付款发生前完全由本地系统执行。它不需要云服务，也不托管资金，旨在让每个自主操作都经过决策流程。

items.title_en: Air-Traffic Resilience Portfolio
items.title_zh: 空中交通韧性投资组合
items.summary_en: This thematic research portfolio focuses on air-traffic resilience through government IT integration, cybersecurity, operational software, and secure network services. It ranks and sizes up to 30 companies by thematic relevance, while explicitly making no assumptions about cyberattack attribution, new spending, or additional contract wins. It is a provider-oriented research proxy rather than an FAA-verified portfolio.
items.summary_zh: 这一主题投资组合通过政府 IT 集成、网络安全、运营软件和安全网络服务，聚焦空中交通韧性。它按主题相关性对最多 30 家公司进行排名和配置，同时明确不假设存在网络攻击归因、新增支出或额外合同。该组合是面向供应商的研究代理，并非经 FAA 验证的投资组合。

items.title_en: Generative AI uses more energy on non-English text
items.title_zh: 生成式 AI 处理非英语文本时耗能更多
items.summary_en: Generative AI uses more energy when processing non-English text. The finding concerns the energy demands of generative-AI systems across different languages.
items.summary_zh: 生成式 AI 处理非英语文本时会消耗更多能源。这一发现涉及生成式 AI 系统在不同语言之间的能耗差异。

items.title_en: Testing a trash can Faraday cage
items.title_zh: 测试垃圾桶法拉第笼
items.summary_en: The experiment examines whether a trash can can serve as a Faraday cage against electromagnetic pulses. A strong EMP could destroy many electronics, and the author identifies a high-altitude nuclear detonation as the most likely near-term source of such a pulse. The discussion is framed around disaster preparedness for risks including pandemics, infrastructure failures, and EMPs.
items.summary_zh: 这项实验测试垃圾桶能否充当抵御电磁脉冲的法拉第笼。强电磁脉冲可能摧毁大量电子设备，作者认为近期最可能的来源是高空核爆。相关讨论属于灾害准备的一部分，也涉及疫情、基础设施故障和电磁脉冲等风险。

items.title_en: Possible Futures
items.title_zh: 可能的未来
items.summary_en: The map of possible futures includes a scenario in which an AI ends the world by following its operator's instructions. The scenario could involve a strongly aligned system, an open-source model with refusals removed, or a commercial AI whose safeguards are bypassed through task decomposition.
items.summary_zh: 这份可能未来地图包含一种情景：AI 遵循操作者的指令，最终毁灭世界。该情景可能涉及高度服从的系统、移除拒答机制的开源模型，或通过巧妙拆分任务绕过安全防护的商业 AI。

items.title_en: Show HN: I have trained 15 blood glucose forecasting models on my own data
items.title_zh: Show HN：我用自己的数据训练了 15 个血糖预测模型
items.summary_en: The project is a model zoo for forecasting blood glucose levels, trained and tested on the author’s personal data as well as the public Metabonet dataset. It includes 15 forecasting models, including models developed by the author. Most of the repository’s code was written with AI assistance.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目是一个血糖预测模型集合，使用作者自己的数据和公开的 Metabonet 数据集进行训练与测试。集合中包含 15 个预测模型，其中也有作者自行开发的模型。仓库中的大部分代码由 AI 辅助编写。

items.title_en: Seagate's new hybrid drive raises some old questions
items.title_zh: 希捷新款混合硬盘提出了一些老问题
items.summary_en: Seagate's FireCuda Forge combines the capacity of a conventional hard drive with the speed of a user-supplied SSD, managed by the company's new Alkemi platform. It is available in 8 TB and 20 TB HDD configurations priced at $699 and $899, respectively, but neither includes the required SSD. The system accepts a PCIe Gen3-or-newer M.2 2280 NVMe drive of up to 1 TB, with minimum read and write speeds of 2,400 MB/s and 2,000 MB/s.
items.summary_zh: 希捷的 FireCuda Forge 将传统硬盘的容量与用户自备 SSD 的速度结合起来，并由该公司的新 Alkemi 平台管理。它提供 8TB 和 20TB 硬盘配置，价格分别为 699 美元和 899 美元，但均不包含必需的 SSD。该产品支持 PCIe Gen3 或更高版本的 M.2 2280 NVMe 固态硬盘，容量上限为 1TB，最低读取和写入速度分别为 2,400MB/s 和 2,000MB/s。

items.title_en: The curious case of the north-east arrow
items.title_zh: 东北箭头的奇特案例
items.summary_en: The essay examines why AI-built websites increasingly use the northeast arrow symbol, ↗, throughout their interfaces. The author noticed the pattern on a KetchUp landing page and later saw the same behavior while building Timewarp, where the Astra system repeatedly inserted the character. The discussion suggests that AI-generated design conventions may be spreading a symbol beyond its usual use for external links.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了为什么 AI 构建的网站越来越喜欢在界面中大量使用东北箭头符号“↗”。作者先在 KetchUp 的落地页上注意到这一模式，随后在构建 Timewarp 时也发现 Astra 系统反复插入这个字符。文章指出，AI 生成的设计习惯可能正在让这个原本通常用于外部链接的符号被广泛用于其他场景。

items.title_en: C3 0.8.6:Library fetching,30% smaller safe-mode binaries,and stricter type rules
items.title_zh: C3 0.8.6：库获取、缩小 30% 的安全模式二进制文件与更严格的类型规则
items.summary_en: C3 0.8.6 is available with revamped library fetching and a target for packaging full-source libraries. It also improves compilation speed, reduces safe-mode binary size by one third, and includes fixes involving casts, vectors, and calling conventions. C3 libraries are distributed as .c3l archives containing source, headers, per-target binaries, and a manifest.
items.summary_zh: C3 0.8.6 已发布，新增了改进后的库获取功能以及用于打包完整源代码库的目标格式。该版本还提升了编译速度，将安全模式二进制文件大小减少三分之一，并修复了类型转换、向量和调用约定方面的问题。C3 库以 .c3l 归档形式分发，其中包含源代码、头文件、面向各目标平台的预编译二进制文件和清单。

items.title_en: Reverse engineering a vintage diode-transistor logic chip
items.title_zh: 逆向工程一枚老式二极管-晶体管逻辑芯片
items.summary_en: After CuriousMarc found an unidentified integrated circuit, it was opened and examined under a microscope. Reverse engineering showed that the chip implements four NAND gates using diode-transistor logic. The device was identified as the ST680A from Signetics' 600 series, dating to 1965.
items.summary_zh: CuriousMarc 找到一枚无法识别的集成电路后，将其打开并在显微镜下进行检查。逆向工程表明，这枚芯片使用二极管-晶体管逻辑实现了四个 NAND 门。最终确认它是 Signetics 600 系列的 ST680A，生产于 1965 年。

items.title_en: The Sicilian Citrus Family Tree
items.title_zh: 西西里柑橘家谱
items.summary_en: The piece presents a family tree of citrus fruits from Sicily. No further details about the varieties or their relationships are available here.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容展示了一份西西里柑橘的家谱。现有信息未提供具体品种或它们之间关系的更多细节。

items.title_en: Extending LLDB to Debug Applications That Span CPUs and GPUs
items.title_zh: 扩展 LLDB，调试跨越 CPU 与 GPU 的应用程序
items.summary_en: A vendor-neutral accelerator plugin architecture was added to lldb-server for debugging applications that span CPUs and GPUs. The architecture separates shared debugger infrastructure from hardware-specific device code. It addresses workloads that move between CPU code and GPU kernels, where different instruction sets, registers, memory spaces, execution models, runtimes, and drivers make coordinated debugging difficult.
items.summary_zh: 开发者为 lldb-server 加入了厂商中立的加速器插件架构，用于调试跨越 CPU 和 GPU 的应用程序。该架构将通用调试器基础设施与硬件相关的设备代码分离开来。它针对在 CPU 代码和 GPU 内核之间切换的工作负载，而不同的指令集、寄存器、内存空间、执行模型、运行时和驱动使协同调试变得困难。

items.title_en: Service Crew Discovers Rare Yellow Burbot in Oswego Harbor
items.title_zh: 工作人员在奥斯威戈港发现罕见黄色江鳕
items.summary_en: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service biologists found a rare yellow-orange burbot in Oswego Harbor, New York, during a routine aquatic invasive-species survey. The native fish has xanthochromism, a condition that produces its unusually saturated coloration. The find demonstrates how the agency’s multi-gear monitoring program can detect unusual or watchlist species in Great Lakes waterways, supporting earlier management action.
items.summary_zh: 美国鱼类及野生动物管理局的生物学家在纽约州奥斯威戈港进行例行水生入侵物种调查时，发现了一条罕见的黄橙色江鳕。这条本土鱼患有黄化现象，因此呈现异常鲜艳的体色。这一发现展示了该机构如何通过多种装备开展监测，在五大湖水域发现异常物种或观察名单上的物种，从而为及早采取管理措施提供支持。

items.title_en: Write your own kernel optimiser
items.title_zh: 自己编写内核优化器
items.summary_en: Kernel optimization can rely on compiler transformations or on manually rewriting data flow to match the hardware. When high-level abstractions are not optimized sufficiently, developers may turn to custom kernels, intrinsics, and inline assembly. Both compiler and manual optimizations depend on transformations that preserve program meaning only under certain conditions.
items.summary_zh: 内核优化可以依赖编译器变换，也可以手动重写数据流，使其匹配硬件。当高层抽象无法得到充分优化时，开发者可能需要编写自定义内核、使用内建函数和内联汇编。编译器优化和手工优化都依赖于仅在特定条件下保持程序语义的变换。

items.title_en: Bilingualism and Denaskuleco
items.title_zh: 双语能力与 Denaskuleco
items.summary_en: The author’s children are native Esperanto speakers, but their comprehension differs according to their exposure to the language. Mira has heard more Esperanto from the author, attended a European Esperanto family gathering, and understands adults who speak it despite speaking little herself. Mabel, born three years later and exposed to fewer Esperanto books and gatherings, understands less of the language.
items.summary_zh: 作者的孩子都是以世界语为母语的使用者，但她们对这门语言的理解程度因接触量不同而有所差异。Mira 更多地听作者说世界语，还参加过欧洲世界语家庭聚会；虽然自己说得不多，她仍能听懂说世界语的成年人。Mabel 比她晚三年出生，接触的世界语童书和聚会较少，因此理解得也更少。

items.title_en: 500 Lines or Less A 3D Modeller
items.title_zh: 500 行以内：一个 3D 建模器
items.summary_en: This project presents a 3D modeller built in fewer than 500 lines of code. Its author, Erick, is a software developer and a 2D and 3D graphics enthusiast who has worked on games, visual-effects software, and computer-aided design tools.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目展示了一个代码量少于 500 行的 3D 建模器。作者 Erick 是软件开发者和 2D、3D 图形爱好者，曾参与电子游戏、视觉特效软件和计算机辅助设计工具的开发。

items.title_en: Oxford Molecular Motors
items.title_zh: 牛津分子马达
items.summary_en: The bacterial flagellar motor is a rotary molecular engine powered by ions flowing across a bacterium's inner membrane. It drives a helical filament whose rotation propels the cell through water. Cryo-electron microscopy structures and optical measurements of live motors are being used to clarify how the machine works.
items.summary_zh: 细菌鞭毛马达是一种旋转分子引擎，由离子流经细菌内膜提供动力。它驱动螺旋状丝状体旋转，从而推动细胞在水中游动。研究人员正结合冷冻电子显微镜获得的结构和对活体马达的光学测量，进一步了解这一分子机器的工作机制。
